newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Citibank's A$150 mln issue priced at 36 bp over.
newsitem.headline: Citibank's A$150 mln issue priced at 36 bp over.

text.p: Citibank Ltd said its A$150 million transferable certificates of deposit (TCDs) announced on Wednesday have been priced at 36 basis points over the March 2002 government bond.
The TCDs, which mature March 15 2002 and carry a coupon of 7.0 percent, were launched off the issuer's A$500 million funding programme announced earlier this year.
The arranger and lead manager is Citisecurities and dealers are Westpac and Commonwealth Bank of Australia.
The pricing had been initially planned for next Monday.

"Demand was so strong and we have got the close out of the (June bond) futures contracts on that day we thought we would bring it forward," said Michael Cunningham, Head of Money Markets and Funding at Citibank.
"Even at 36 basis points over we were about 120 percent oversubscribed, so it was a very successful issue," he added.
Earlier this week, Standard & Poor's rated the funding programme AA-minus based on Citibank's ultimate ownership by, and integration with, the U.S.-based Citicorp group.
